# PROGRESS — Spec Requirement Implementation Tracker

**Purpose:** Tracks every SR from the 14 expanded specs with its implementation status. Build chat updates this file as SRs move through the pipeline.

**Created:** 2026-04-11 (Phase 3 Build Environment Setup)
**Generated by:** `validation/_generate_progress.py`

**Total SRs:** 484

### Row Type Breakdown

| Type | Count | What It Means |
|------|------:|---------------|
| Main flow (`---`) | 414 | Features and behaviors. Each is an implementable unit. |
| System Exception (`SE`) | 28 | Infrastructure failure handlers (network, auth, timeout, resource exhaustion). |
| Business Exception (`BE`) | 42 | Logic/validation failure handlers (invalid input, policy violation, permission denied). |
| **TOTAL** | **484** | Main flows drive implementation scope; exception rows drive resilience coverage. |

**Reading this table:** When tracking implementation velocity, the main-flow count (414) represents the number of distinct features and behaviors. Completing a main-flow SR means the happy path works. Completing its associated SE and BE rows means the error paths are also covered. "20 SRs implemented" typically means ~8-12 features with their exception handlers.

---

## Status Legend

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| Not Started | No code exists for this SR. Default starting state. |
| In Progress | Code is being written for this SR. Not yet complete. |
| Implemented | Code exists and covers the main flow and all relevant SE/BE rows. No tests yet. |
| Tested | Tests exist per `generate-test-from-spec` and all pass. |
| Verified | `implementation-reviewer` agent has approved the implementation against the spec. Ready to commit. |
| Blocked | Halted pending clarification from Nick. See LOG.md for context. |

**Transition rule:** Not Started -> In Progress -> Implemented -> Tested -> Verified. Blocked can come from any state and returns to the state that was active before the block.
